task.question: What was the number of people killed in the mass shooting at Tumbler Ridge Secondary School in British Columbia, Canada, in February 2026?
task.evidence: February 10 – At least nine people, including the perpetrator, are killed, and 27 are injured in a mass shooting at Tumbler Ridge Secondary School and at a residence in Tumbler Ridge, British Columbia, Canada.

answer: FINAL: The number of people killed at Tumbler Ridge Secondary School in the February 2026 shooting was 6 people (not counting the shooter, who also died). The total death toll including those killed at her home was 9 people.

messages.content: [2026 Tumbler Ridge shooting] On February 10, 2026, a mass shooting occurred in Tumbler Ridge, British Columbia, Canada. On that afternoon, Jesse Van Rootselaar killed her mother and half-brother at their home before going to Tumbler Ridge Secondary School, where she killed six people and injured 27 others before killing herself. Van Rootselaar was a former student of the school. The incident was the deadliest mass shooting in Canada since the Nova Scotia attacks in 2020 and the deadliest school shooting in Canada since the École Polytechnique massacre in 1989. | other articles: Tumbler Ridge Secondary School, Tumbler Ridge

FINAL: The number of people killed at Tumbler Ridge Secondary School in the February 2026 shooting was 6 people (not counting the shooter, who also died). The total death toll including those killed at her home was 9 people.
